title: Loan IQ IT Solutions Architecture Lead Analyst
description_html: The Loan IQ IT Solutions Architecture Lead Analyst is a strategic professional responsible for design and implementation of technology solutions delivered by Wholesale Lending Technology within the Product Technology Chief Information Office. The individual will partner with key internal stakeholders (Operations, Technology, Banking, Markets and Risk) to drive end-to-end delivery on a Loan IQ & several in-house technology tools built around loan IQ that fully supports, satisfies and anticipates the reporting needs of the business and our regulators. This role is responsible for Global Loan IQ business enablement, Loan IQ Workflow Automation and implementation of AI driven solutions for loans.  Recognized technical subject matter authority for Loan IQ and Loan products. This role requires a broad and comprehensive understanding of multiple systems, theories and practices related to Loan IQ and Lending functions. Excellent communication and diplomacy skills are required to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external stakeholders. Oversees implementation of data driven technical solutions to meet business need. Responsible for ensuring that solutions align with Loan IQ Architecture strategy, while balancing success criteria, interface impacts, system performance, controls, scalability, and cost.    Responsibilities:      Delivery of business requirements, in partnership with Product Owner Team, to ensure that business/use case, system configuration and other global impacts are fully defined.      Lead the definition and ongoing management of architecture for Loan IQ and its ancillary workflow applications.    Establish a governance process to oversee implementation activities and ensure ongoing alignment to Citi Data standards and strategic architecture goals for our organization.    Ability to write database queries in SQL against the Loan IQ database to extract and query data in support of changes being analyzed.    SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.    Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.     Recommended Qualifications :     6+ years with Loan IQ analysis and implementations, with deep domain knowledge of Loan IQ and its data model, database schema, APIs, and SDK capabilities.    Demonstrated influencing, presentation, facilitation and partnering skills      Analytical, flexible, team-oriented and have good interpersonal/communication skills. Robust problem-solving skills.      Previous experience with AI tools utilization and agile delivery (Jira, Confluence)    Ability to manage multiple activities and changing priorities and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines       Education:      Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience     This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed.
